name: flowcommit
author: Bashar Bhuiyan
description: Visual version control and an IDE for vibe coders: design your app as a flowchart, let AI agents build it, and keep every version in Git.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @flowcommit/server" "npm run dev -w @flowcommit/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/web
scripts.screenshots: npm run build && SCREENSHOTS=1 playwright test e2e/screenshots.spec.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
